roleContext.roleTitle: Customer Support Team Lead, Help Desk Software
roleContext.jobDescription: The help desk software company supports its business customers through a tiered support organisation. The Customer Support Team Lead runs a tier-one team of eight agents: sets the shift rota and the queue assignments, coaches agents on ticket handling against the quality rubric, runs the weekly quality review, escalates tier-two issues under the escalation procedure, and reports the team's response and resolution metrics. Hiring, pay and disciplinary decisions for agents stay with the support manager. Reports to the support manager; works with the tier-two engineers, the quality team and the workforce planning analyst.

requirements.text: Runs a tier-one support team's shift rota and queue assignments.
Coaches agents on ticket handling against the quality rubric and runs the weekly quality review.
Escalates tier-two issues under the escalation procedure and records own responsibility boundaries.
Reports the team's response and resolution metrics to the support manager each week.
Documents team hand-over conditions and open issues for the support manager.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Customer Support Team Lead, Help Desk Software

## Experience

- Team lead for a tier-one support team of seven agents at a software company for two years, setting the shift rota and the queue assignments each week in the workforce tool.
- Coached the agents on ticket handling against the company's quality rubric, running the weekly quality review with the quality team's sampled tickets and recording the coaching notes in the agents' files.
- Escalated tier-two issues under the escalation procedure through the escalation queue, recording in each escalation which checks were mine and which belonged to the tier-two engineer.
- Reported the team's response and resolution metrics to the support manager each week from the ticketing system's dashboard, with the weekly reports filed in the team folder.
- Hiring, pay and disciplinary matters for the agents stayed with the support manager; my role covered rota, coaching, escalation and reporting.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one month's shift rotas, one weekly quality review record with coaching notes, and four weekly metrics reports, with the ticketing system and workforce tool references as a verification trail.
